extraction.NOTES: Document is a partially legible Application for a Patent in Fee (Act of May 8, 1906, 34 Stat., 182). Fragmentary responses visible: Age appears to be 31; single status noted as 44 (possibly age at marriage or illegible); degree of blood 1/4; attended school; does not use intoxicants; land described with partial references to allotment numbers 22 3.2404 and 22 8.2442; question 13 references 60 acres of land; land is leased. Most responses are illegible or cut off. Form number 6-2543 / 6-243 visible.

tables.title: Application for Patent in Fee - Competency Questions and Answers

rows.Question: Age?
Degree of blood?
Married or single?
Did you attend school? If so, where and how long?
rows.Answer: 5 yrs Stephan Indian Mission Hyde Co. SD, 2 yrs Chamberlain SD

rows.Question: Do you use intoxicants?
Are you in good physical condition?
What is the value of the land covered by your application?
Does your application cover your own allotment or inherited land?
Does your application cover all or a part of your land?
Do you cultivate your land?
Have you any other occupation?
Are you self-supporting? If so, how is your self-support obtained?
Have you accumulated any property? If so, what?
rows.Answer: 80 acres of land and 40 horses and 125 head cattle also farming implements

rows.Question: Are you in debt? If so, whom do you owe, how much, and for what, and have you given security for the debts?
Have you been given a patent in fee for a part of your land? If so, did you sell it, and what use did you make of the proceeds of the sale?
Have you any inherited land? If so, what is your interest in the estate and what is the value of the allotment?
Have you sold any inherited land? If so, what use was made of the proceeds?
Have you any individual Indian money to your credit with the superintendent? If so, how much?
Have you been given the privilege of leasing your own land?
Is your land leased? If so, what rent do you receive?
rows.Answer: I am using my own land
